description: This file contains unit tests for DynamoDB storage operations in AWSUtils. It verifies CRUD operations, conditional updates, and concurrency control mechanisms such as etag validation using the xUnit testing framework.

classes.name: DynamoDBStorageTests
classes.description: Unit test class for DynamoDB storage operations, implementing tests for create, read, update, delete, and query functionalities.

methods.name: DynamoDBStorageTests
methods.description: Constructor that initializes test setup, including checking DynamoDB availability and setting up the data manager.

methods.name: GenerateNewData
methods.description: Generates a new test data object with unique partition and row keys.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManager_CreateItemAsync
methods.description: Tests creating a new item with conditional expression to prevent overwriting existing items.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManager_UpsertItemAsync
methods.description: Tests upserting (insert or update) of items with and without conditional expressions.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManager_DeleteItemAsync
methods.description: Tests deleting an item from DynamoDB and verifying its removal.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManager_ReadSingleTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Tests reading a single entry from the table, including a case where the item does not exist.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManager_ReadAllTableEntryByPartitionAsync
methods.description: Tests querying all entries under a specific partition key.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of key attributes (PartitionKey and RowKey) for a data object.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of attribute values for persistence, optionally including key attributes.
